standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-a-hou.speaker: Cockatrice
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-a-hou.text: [House owner] deaded me! That wasn't very nice!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-the-h.speaker: Cockatrice
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-the-h.text: What did you do that for?

options.text: A slayer master told me to

steps.player: A slayer master told me to.

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: Why do the slayer masters all pick on poor cockatrice?

steps.player: They pick on lots of other creatures too.

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: Then mount one of them on your wall and let poor cockatrice rest in peace!

options.text: So I could mount your head on my wall

steps.player: So I could mount your head on my wall.

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: Another cockatrice falls victim to the dreaded mirror shield!

steps.player: Don't take it personally! You look good on my wall!

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: I don't care! I think I looked better with a body!

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: I will kill you with my paralyzing-type magic eyes look!

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: Dots appear in air between eyes and victim. Dot! Dot! Dotty!

steps.speaker: Cockatrice
steps.text: Concentrates mental power. Eyes narrow beak clenches veins on head stand out.

steps.player: You're dead, cockatrice. Your eyes are glass beads. It won't work.
I think I'll leave you to it.
